verdict.rationale: Formant is a robot fleet-operations platform, and sensor bring-up is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows a Docker/ROS agent install, an Agent SDK for ingesting telemetry, and commands such as publishing to ROS topics. Nothing documents ready-made drivers or standard message types for cameras, lidars, IMUs, or GPS, and ingesting existing ROS data is an adjacent capability, not hardware integration.
